name: Avoma
description:
Connect Claude to your Avoma workspace and get meeting intelligence, including call transcripts, AI-generated notes, scorecard results, and usage analytics. Ask Claude about stalled deals, review rep scorecards, track quota attainment, or walk into your next call with full account history.

Read capabilities:
- Meeting transcripts, structured notes, and AI summaries
- Scorecard evaluations and team usage / engagement metrics
- CRM deal stages, CRM associations, meeting outcomes, meeting types, and team listings

Write capabilities:
- Update meeting outcomes
- Set meeting privacy — private, organization, public, or team-scoped
- Assign meeting types / purposes 

You can use the Avoma connector to:

- Review calls and action items:
 "Summarise my calls from last week and list open action items"
- Check team scorecards:
 "Show me scorecard results for the sales team this month and identify the three  coaching areas with the lowest average scores."
- Find meetings by deal stage:
"Find all meetings linked to Closed Won deals over $50,000 that closed in Q2 2026 and summarize the common buying signals."
- Update meeting outcomes:
"Set the outcome of my demo call with Acme Corp from June 15 to Qualified”
- Manage meeting privacy:
"Make all onboarding calls for the Globex account from the past 30 days visible only to the Customer Success team."
- Create playbook:
"Analyze win/loss calls for Enterprise deals over $100,000 that closed in the last two quarters and create a coaching playbook with examples of effective discovery questions, objection handling, and closing techniques."

Access is controlled by your Avoma permissions and OAuth 2.1 credentials. No meeting data is stored by Anthropic. Works across Claude.ai, Claude Desktop, and Claude Code.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Avoma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Avoma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.avoma.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Avoma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoma lists 14 MCP tools, including get_current_datetime, get_meeting, get_meeting_notes, get_meeting_transcript, list_deal_stages, list_meeting_outcomes, list_meeting_types, list_meetings, list_scorecard_evaluations, list_team_usage_metrics, list_teams, and set_meeting_outcome.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Avoma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Avoma in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Avoma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Avoma is developed by Avoma. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
